inputs.selection_reason: large replay with exact FocusProjectiles extension

order: For each build/mode: A/A control, then baseline/candidate; each series alternates AB, BA by pair.
preflight: Two unmeasured exports per build/mode, strict fingerprint equality required before any timed series.
measurement: Full export on same host, same session, default features and fixed release builds. Warm cache, no affinity override, outputs hashed outside measured interval. All samples retained; no outlier deletion.
noise_rule: Report per-pair range and A/A control; effects overlapping A/A variation or changing direction are INCONCLUSIVE. No confidence interval or universal speed claim.
repeat_budget: One primary series; at most one predeclared confirmatory series if a concrete ambiguity remains. No favorable-sample selection.
host_limitation: No exclusive-host, power-state, or cold-storage guarantee.
